title: Messages
overview: This guide covers messages workflows for Provider.

subtasks.title: Messages (secure in-app collaboration)
subtasks.purpose: Send and receive HIPAA-scoped in-app messages with practice peers and caregivers, with patient-context vitals visible in the reading pane.

steps.title: Filter Message Threads
steps.description: Use the tabs to filter Unread / Flagged / All threads.

steps.title: Open a Thread
steps.description: Click a thread in the list to open it in the reading pane.

steps.title: Read Vital Snapshot
steps.description: Read the Focused Vital Snapshot (right side) for the patient tied to the thread.

steps.title: Reply to Message
steps.description: Type a reply in the composer and click Send.

steps.title: Compose New Message
steps.description: Click + New Message to compose — pick recipient(s), optionally link a patient, add subject and body, then Send.

steps.title: Flag or Archive Thread
steps.description: Flag, mark unread or archive a thread from the action bar above the reading pane. Notes Messages are patient-context aware — linking a patient to a thread exposes recent vitals in the Focused Vital Snapshot panel. Threads are retained per practice retention policy; nothing is deleted permanently within the standard retention window. Task 8.7 — Settings
